scope: unmerged third ordered FreeCAD development default-importer patch
base: FreeCAD d956ec561639cfa83f755504b1b3358ea799428e with prior SOLID OCS and planar 3DFACE patches applied
nativeBuild: Headless macOS ARM64 FreeCADCmd from exact source archive 29bdfe30632e084c0b6d015a1258f0ff75b8ed84fca660cec4e74fd4e2604bb9; AppleClang 21, Qt 6.12, OCCT 7.9.3; prior two patches applied
baseline: POLYLINE header group 70 and each VERTEX group 70 share the same destination; child flags overwrite parent flags. Generated closed 2D and 3D polylines lose the closing edge; generated polyface creates a wire through an irrelevant (0,0,0) face record, while polygon mesh is reduced to a wire without reporting a loss.
change: Capture parent flags before reading child records; retain them when emitting ordinary polylines. Consume polygon-mesh/polyface records without fabricating wires and report the unsupported mesh family. Preserve continuation when SEQEND is absent. This guard does not implement mesh import.

validation.unit: Actual generated-source FreeCAD import test: 8 cases for open/closed 2D and 3D, missing SEQEND, polygon mesh, polyface and mesh with missing SEQEND. Expected following LINE and unsupported-feature disposition checked; original importer fails, patched importer passes.
validation.native: Separate ezdxf-generated controls: both closed 2D and 3D have four edges rather than three; POLYFACE and polygon mesh have no fabricated wire and are explicitly reported; following LINE geometry is unchanged.
validation.combined: SOLID OCS, planar 3DFACE and classic-polyline regression tests pass together on the rebuilt FreeCAD importer. Three patches apply in order to the exact FreeCAD revision.

limits: All three downstream FreeCAD default-importer patches remain unmerged. Native checks use headless Import.readDXF into isolated fresh documents; GUI open/insert and Linux/Windows are not tested.
POLYFACE and polygon-mesh semantics, including edge visibility and per-face styling, remain unsupported, not qualified.
No producer-authored source, arbitrary nested transformation, binary DXF, 3D solid or broad mesh support is implied.
Scratch DXFs are not committed; no phase or support claim is promoted.
